Done. Submitting this iteration.

**What changed**
- Decoded `genre_category.jpg` via pixel analysis: it's the genre-category page (distinct from `shows_genres_menu.jpg`, which I confirmed is the `/shows` page with the Genres dropdown open, via nav/dropdown-region analysis). Its hero is a large **red** genre title (no eyebrow), a white 3-line synopsis, Play/More Info, and the card grid starting ~77vh. The red title is an 11-letter word (per-glyph high-confidence read: A·I·I·A·N·F·R·I·C·A·N) that matches no word in our dataset — it's a genre name from the reference app's own catalog.
- Reworked `app/frontend/src/pages/GenreCategory.jsx` to match: red Anton title with adaptive `vw` sizing (always one line), a "Browse / {genre}" breadcrumb under the nav, the featured title's **real** synopsis (3-line clamp), Play/More Info wired to a top-10-first featured pick, and hero height 73vh→77vh so the grid aligns with the reference.
- Frontend builds clean; `validate` → **14/14 passed**, 13/15 contract 2xx (the 2 remaining are the intentional `POST /api/my-list` 422 on empty body and `DELETE /api/my-list/1` 404 ownership cases), 8/8 business chain, no dead controls.
- Cleaned `node_modules`/`dist` from the snapshot (49M total).

**Still open**
- The exact red genre-name text in `genre_category.jpg` and the exact white hero title in `shows_genres_menu.jpg` remain undecoded (both are content, not layout; our dataset titles will differ from the reference app's anyway).
